'''Nar Chunna''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Nar Chunna system/Legends|Nar Chunna system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Kor Hestilic system/Legends|Kor Hestilic]] and [[Kor Utoradii system/Legends|Kor Utoradii systems]]. It was rumored that large amounts of priceless artifacts could be obtained on Nar Chunna.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So I began penciling in new worlds. Some got Hutt-sounding names&mdash;Nar Chunna and Nar Haaska, for instance.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>}}
Nar Chunna was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" /> In a 2009 article published on [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu.com]], Fry noted that Nar Chunna was among those Hutt Space worlds created for ''The Essential Atlas'' that received "Hutt-sounding" names.<ref name="Suvudu" />
